chat.t: Ah, ah. Requesting connection, requesting connection.
Hey there! You're that Fixer from the rumors, right?
I am Sir Romance!
I've got a request for you!

o: What?
Oh, a client?

chat.t: Speaking casually even after realizing I'm a client?
I knew it, you truly are a person overflowing with romance!
When I heard you broke out of the Panoticon, I just knew you were full of romance!

o: What does that have to do with anything...?
Well, I am pretty full of romance.
So, what kind of request do you have for me?

chat.t: Hehehe.
And that is...
Catching a Flurry!!
Well? Aren't you excited already?!

o: ...Well, just come to my office first.
That's where I usually sign contracts.

chat.t: Hehehe.
Well? Isn't your heart pounding at the thought of hunting Flurries already?
Ah, how incredibly full of romance this is!

o: I feel like I just signed a contract with a weirdo.

chat.t: A weirdo?!
Don't you know that dreamers are always a little crazy?

o: That's "a little," but this is way past that.

chat.t: It's fine! You'll be just as excited as I am soon enough.
Next time we meet, I'll show you what a truly romantic hunt is all about!
See you next time!

o: She seriously just said her piece and disappeared.

lines.t: Hideout Reception Room
The day arrived for the client who submitted the puzzling Flurry hunt request to show up.
I only called her over because she was pretty, but...
I hope she's not a weirdo.
I hope she doesn't look completely different in person...
If she does, I'm kicking her out immediately.
I have arrived!
Where are you, Fixer?!  I've been waiting forever!
She is pretty, but...
This is way more than I expected.
Ahaha! Hello, Fixer!
I can't believe you didn't even flinch when I burst in like this...!
You truly are a person of romance!
What is she even talking about?
Oh, come on, no need to hide it!
The motto of the Great Flurry Hunters! It is romance!
And I am none other than!  the Captain of this great hunting guild!
Never heard of it.
Are you guys even famous?
*Flinch!*
W-We'll be famous soon! We're just in the starting phase!
I've never seen anyone actually say 'flinch' out loud before...
H-Hmph! Just bring me some tea first! I am a client, you know!
...Fine, just take a seat first.
Mmhmm!
Now that I've got my tea, shall we talk about the request?
Took you long enough.
Ahem! Anyway, my request is! to find the Romantic Flurry!
The Romantic Flurry? What's that?
Exactly, exactly!
They say there's a treasure vault somewhere in this world that holds all the romance in existence!
And the key to it is none other than... held by a Flurry!
So my request is! To hunt down this Romantic Flurry together!
But I refuse.
Whyyyy?!
It's a treasure vault with all the romance in the world! Isn't that amazing?!
Romance my foot.
That won't put food on the table.
No, come on, think about it one more time!
I told you, I'm not interested.
What do I do? My plan to recruit him into the Flurry Hunters using this request is... I can't let a new recruit slip away like this...
What are you whispering about?
Urgh... Fine! If we find the key to the treasure vault, I'll give you half of the treasure! How's that?
Just half? No deal.
Ugh, then how much do you want?
Two-thirds of the treasure.
Mmm...
Well, fine! Romance is way more important to me than treasure anyway!
Hehe, I'll quickly draw up a plan and get in touch!
I knew it! You really are a wonderful person who appreciates romance!
Yeah, yeah, whatever you say... Here, sign the contract.

Sir Romance, who had been making a racket for a while,
hastily filled out the request form and vanished like the wind.
...She really is a noisy one, rambling on about romance.
I have a bad feeling things are about to get exhausting...

chat.t: Hey, hey, hey!
You're not still sleeping, are you?
Today is the hunt we've been waiting for, you're not sleeping in, are you?!

o: You're too loud.
There's still plenty of time before our meeting. Why are you so hyper?

chat.t: Isn't it obvious?
Today is the big day you embark on your very first Flurry hunt!
Now, let me tell you what you need to bring!
First, a water bottle, a sleeping bag, traps, Flurry bait, a grappling hook, a capture net, binoculars, a handkerchief, three days of portable rations, spare clothes, a first-aid kit, and...

o: Stop, stop.
How am I supposed to bring all of that?

chat.t: I didn't even finish the list yet!
Then just bring some snacks!
Since it's your first time, I'll prepare the rest as a special treat!
Don't be late!
Saying that my actions aren't romantic...
Is something I still can't accept!
So, I'll be looking forward to it!
To seeing how the world defines romance!

o: That sounds a lot like 'I am the world.'

chat.t: How did you even get that out of what I said?!
But, if what you call romance is the real deal...
I suppose I'll have to admit it.

o: At least you're open-minded.
I'll show you what true romance is.

chat.t: Yep! See you next time!

lines.t: A city alleyway
Footprints over here!
Feathers over here!
Signs of Flurries are everywhere!
Kyaaa! I have a feeling we're going to catch a ton of Flurries today!
We can really catch Flurries in a place like this?
Would a Flurry—especially a legendary one—even appear right in the middle of the city?
You know nothing!
Flurries are settled all over the world!
We can't miss out on romance that could show up anytime, anywhere, can we?
That's not romance, that's just a complete lack of planning.
...Ahem! Anyway! The search starts now!
It's time for some romantic fun that'll completely turn that grumpy look of yours upside down!
Alright! Try to keep up with my pace!
Yep, today is not going to be easy...
Downtown
Ah! Look over there! It's a Flurry!
Hey!! Wait!!
Haha! Too slow, Fix—Waaaaah!
Tsk, I knew this would happen.
Watch where you're going! Honestly, what is wrong with people!
Ugh, I'm sorry...
Park
Oh, look! A Flurry on the lake!
Heh, I won't let it get away this time!
Whoa! Cold!
Fixer! Watch closely as I catch it!
Kyaah! Someone fell into the lake!

After getting caught up in a few more accidents
while trying to stop Sir Romance's eccentric behavior, evening had arrived before I knew it.
Whew... How could we not catch a single one!
The process was romantic, but the results certainly weren't...
It's okay! Because we always have tomorrow!
Haha! Of course! That was our promise, wasn't it!
(This can't go on. At this rate, I'll be checking in to the Panoticon every single day.)
Hey, you...
...Do you even know what romance actually is?
*Flinch!*
You've been going on and on about romance without even knowing what it means?
I knew it. *Sigh*...
N-No, that's not true! Of course I know what romance is!
L-Like doing things people don't usually do! That's what romance is!
How on earth is that romance?
What you did today was just eccentric antics.
Ugh... T-Then what is romance?!
Hmm... Alright. Let's change the terms of our contract, then.
I'll teach you what romance is. In exchange, all the treasure is mine.
That's just you robbing me blind!
Then you can keep living without knowing what romance is.
But you'll get to realize what true romance is.
T-Then show me what your romance is first. I'll decide after that.
Suit yourself.
Sir Romance went back with a pensive expression.

chat.t: Is today finally the day?
The day I get to experience your true romance!

o: If there's ever a competition for speaking needlessly grandly, you should enter.
Because you'd easily take first place.

chat.t: Hehehe.
Isn't this also romance?
Ah.
Wait, is this not romance?

o: Well,
I suppose you could look at it as romantic in a way.
Meet me where I told you.

chat.t: Alright! Let's go!
I had fun today!
I feel like I've gotten a little closer to my romantic journey, thanks to you!
Thank you!
You definitely have what it takes to join our squad.
Instead of being a Fixer, why not join the Flurry Hunters?

o: But I decline.
I'm comfortable here.

chat.t: Hmm.
Well, our door will always be open for you.
So let me know if you ever change your mind!
You must!!!

o: I'll think about it.

chat.t: Hehe, great!

lines.t: Tofu Street
Whoa! They're selling tofu everywhere!
What is this place? A temple built for worshiping tofu?!
It's the landmark of the Panoticon. Tofu Street.
Wait, have you seriously never been inside the Panoticon?
Hmm, nope. I've never been caught by the police before.
Don't tell me... do you only get "romance" by going to the Panoticon...?
Should I go flip over that tofu stall over there?!
Hey, stop.
If you do that, we won't have time to explore true romance.
Ugh... Then what should we do!
Go buy some Tofu Ice Cream. A big one, if possible.
And when you buy it, make sure to say, "Please make it as soft as my breasts and as sweet as my voice."
No matter how unfamiliar I am with city life, even I know that sounds weird!
You really have no sense of romance.
Ugh... F-Fine, I'll go buy it! I'll buy it!
Park
We got the Tofu Ice Cream to go, and we're just at a park?!
You said you wanted to find romance. Normal people find romance in places like this.
Romance with Tofu Ice Cream...?
Are we supposed to rub the ice cream all over our bodies?!
Not quite.
I suppose that might be romance for some people.
Ugh, this is so hard...
True romance is something you can feel without any incidents or accidents.
Stop trying to pull crazy stunts and just enjoy it.
Ugh... Alright! Let's give it a try your way!
I spent some time sitting on the grass eating ice cream with Sir Romance.
Are we finding some epic romance this time?!
Where is it? Should I scout from up in a tree first?
Calm down. We're just here to take a walk and look at the stars.
Ugh... I really don't get your kind of romance...
I told you before that I came from the wastelands, right? There is absolutely nothing there.
It was a completely empty, endless land of only dust and stones.
In that barren wasteland, I found a single book.
An exciting adventure, and the romance found within it. It was a precious book that guided my wandering life.
Ugh... So honestly, the romance you're teaching me doesn't quite click.
The romance in that book was definitely filled with far more amazing and exciting things.
It's not that I didn't enjoy what you showed me.
But... can something this un-spectacular really be called romance?
Aren't you overthinking it? You can find "romance" even in simple pleasures.
For me, I felt the most romance when you went to buy that Tofu Ice Cream.
Anyway, my point is that you can find small moments of romance without forcing yourself to pull eccentric stunts.
Because everyone's romance is their own.
It makes me feel a bit fluttery... is this what you meant...?
Still, I think I'm starting to get it.
It's still a long way off, but... you're going to keep teaching me, right?
Sure. But I'm still taking the treasure as tuition.
...Can't we go fifty-fifty?
Hey.
